lesson.title: Understanding Ratios
lesson.learningIntention: Understand a ratio as a multiplicative relationship between two quantities.

successCriteria: I can build a ratio with objects.
I can write a ratio three ways.
I can explain what a ratio compares.
selectedSuccessCriterion: I can write a ratio three ways.

reveal.rule: Learning intention and exactly one selected 'I can' are hidden for warm-up and review. They are revealed together immediately after the launch hook, read aloud by two spinner-selected students, and shown again at the midlesson learning check before the Fist-to-Five. Students never see more than one success criterion.

states.loaded: Lesson is a preview. Nothing is timing. Public screens show a calm Loaded card. Pressing Start lesson turns on automatic pacing and starts the current timer.
states.running: Automatic pacing is on. The current timer counts down and the run advances on its own at zero.
states.paused: Holds the current state and stops advancement. The timer freezes on its remaining time.
states.resumed: Continues automatic pacing from the remaining time.
states.stopped: Ends the pacing run. The current state stays on screen but nothing advances until Start lesson is pressed again.
states.timeUp: At zero: show 'Time is up', chime once, hold a brief transition, then advance to the next scheduled state.

pacing.manualNav: Manual Back and Next preserve the current pacing state: running stays running, paused stays paused.

timedResponseCheck.behavior: Closes at zero, shows results briefly, then advances.

endSession.confirmation: Requires confirmation on the private Remote and in the laptop control flow. On confirm, all synchronized surfaces show Session ended and disconnect cleanly.

boardPanel.behavior: Open work space adds a writing panel beside the current problem on the main projector so the problem stays visible. Back to Remote closes the panel and restores the same problem view.

phases.name: Warm-up
phases.chromebook: Assigned Google Form warm-up · 3 fluency + 2 prior-learning retrieval questions
phases.ipad: Timer, Nudge non-starters, Close form; submissions count

phases.name: Review
phases.chromebook: Eyes on the board — brief look at answers
phases.note: Brief look at answers and frequently missed problems. No digital correction flow.

phases.name: Launch
phases.chromebook: I notice that… (open prompt, not the Google Form)
phases.ipad: Reveal final score, Buzzer, Deploy question
phases.note: Uses the beginning halftime score problem. This is not the Google Form.

phases.name: Learning intention and success criterion
phases.main: Learning intention + one selected 'I can': I can write a ratio three ways.
phases.pace: Two readers - follow along, then keep today's target in view
phases.chromebook: Listen to today's two readers (no response control)
phases.ipad: Spin two readers, re-spin, keep target on both public screens
phases.note: First reveal, immediately after the hook. Read by two spinner-selected students. No confidence is collected here; the Fist-to-Five comes at the learning check.

phases.name: Concrete
phases.main: Build it — 3 yellow for every 2 blue (physical counters)

phases.name: Representational
phases.main: Draggable tiles — make 3 yellow for every 2 blue
phases.ipad: Send board model to students, Deploy question

phases.name: Learning check + Fist-to-Five
phases.main: Learning intention + one selected 'I can': I can write a ratio three ways.
phases.chromebook: 0–5 Fist-to-Five buttons — only the teacher sees your number
phases.ipad: Deploy, Reveal anonymous bars, private per-student numbers, readers
phases.note: Second appearance of the learning intention and success criterion; the first is immediately after the hook. Timed response check: closes at zero, shows results briefly, advances.

phases.name: Discussion
phases.pace: Round number + timer + sentence stems + vocabulary
phases.chromebook: Round number, your role, sentence stem
phases.note: Three rounds of 2 minutes. Must include the current prompt, round number, sentence stems, and vocabulary.

phases.name: Independent paper work
phases.main: Practice Set 4 · p. 47 · #1–8 + due/turn-in + help path
phases.chromebook: Directions + one optional assigned manipulative (fraction bars)
phases.ipad: Support tool selector (shows on student screens only when set), Open work space, Blank all screens
phases.note: Paper-first. Show required problem numbers, due and turn-in, help path, and one optional assigned manipulative without reproducing paper problems. Full crafted set required; one optional Big Dog Challenge on the back. One minute moved to the post-hook target reveal.

phases.name: Exit ticket
phases.ipad: Close submissions, private per-student answers, Start closeout
phases.note: Timed response check: closes at zero, shows results briefly, advances to closeout.

phases.name: Closeout
phases.chromebook: Same summary lives on the student Today page afterward
phases.note: Hides empty categories. Shows games or tools only when assigned.
